title: docs: use publisher/model IDs in examples
author: voodoohop

gist.summary: Updated Scalar code samples, gen documentation, the APIDOCS generator’s curated examples, README, BYOP guide, and polli CLI documentation and `keys update` help to use canonical `publisher/model` IDs instead of short aliases. For example, `flux` is shown as `black-forest-labs/flux.1-schnell`; the examples no longer imply that `openai` means every OpenAI model. The examples were checked against `/models`. Bumped polli to 0.1.45 to ship its updated SKILL.md and help text. Aliases still work and CLI defaults are unchanged; the generated APIDOCS.md was not changed.
